# Thread & Signal

Thread & Signal LLC is owned by Charles and Darian Russella in Kent, Ohio. It is building Yardulum, a sales tool for landscapers. Yardulum is in development. Call or text Charles: (330) 357-2440.

- [Yardulum](https://threadandsignal.com/): Yardulum is a sales tool we're building for landscapers: it turns a model of your customer's yard into an itemized estimate, priced from your own price list. The home page shows an illustration with a sample yard and sample prices.
- [How It Works](https://threadandsignal.com/how-it-works/): Four steps. 1: a 3D model of the property built from free public mapping data, with measuring and slope between two tapped points (works today; Thread & Signal builds each model). 2: the landscaper's design drawn on the model (being built). 3: every item priced from the landscaper's own price list, with labor hours (being built). 4: a one-page itemized proposal walked through at the kitchen table (being built). The phone and tablet web app reopens a loaded property without a signal (works today). Yardulum will not price slope; grading will be its own line from the price list. It is not the software landscapers bill or run crews with, and it is meant to work alongside it. It is not a survey.
- [Founders Club](https://threadandsignal.com/founders-club/): Every landscaping company that takes part while Yardulum is built joins the Founders Club and keeps founder pricing for life, locked for as long as they stay subscribed. In-person setup, a price list built with Charles, and in-person sales training. For landscaping companies in Northeast Ohio that sell install work. Yardulum will be a monthly subscription; the price is given in person and in writing. No prices are published.
- [About & Contact](https://threadandsignal.com/contact/): Charles Russella ran his own landscaping and leaf-removal business, has worked a landscaping job for another company, and spent seven years in sales, mortgage lending, and financial-crimes compliance. He is building Yardulum. Darian Russella, co-owner, has a master's in Engineering Management Technology and a background in live broadcast systems. Thread & Signal also sets up local Super Intelligence (SI) systems for businesses near Kent.
- [Open-Source Dev](https://threadandsignal.com/open-source/): The five most-starred original public repositories, refreshed daily.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/crussella0129)

Illustrations on this site use a sample yard and sample prices. They are not screenshots, quotes or customer work. No customer results, prices or dates are claimed. The business line (330) 357-2440 is public; no personal contact details are published.
